title: lepidaploa bakeriana
intro: Lepidaploa bakeriana, commonly known as "Baker's Button", is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in its leaves and roots, which are used to treat various health conditions. Lepidaploa bakeriana has been traditionally used to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues due to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal benefits, including antioxidant, antiproliferative, and anti-inflammatory activities.
